RATIONALE=The current 179/180 implementation has the right bounded components but leaves seven required G3 semantics unwired in production/restart paths. These are correctness work already inside G3, not scope expansion. A 400 gross-addition ceiling gives bounded headroom to finish runtime wiring/recovery without forcing a risky rewrite. It is a ceiling, not a target, and expires when G3 closes.

MASTER_RUNTIME_RULE=Production MASTER truth must initialise from existing runtime configuration: HL_LIVE_HL_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS is the MASTER/trading account; the signing identity is derived from the configured private key/Account and MUST be distinct from MASTER. Missing/invalid/equal identities fail closed. Production account_net_actual has no arbitrary provider fallback. Test injection may remain only behind explicit test seams and must never be reachable as production truth.

IN_FLIGHT_RECOVERY_RULE=Persist each unresolved send reservation inside the EXISTING SERVICE_STATE_FILE before physical exchange.order authority is invoked. Record at minimum intent_id, coin/dex scope if known, planner side, authorised size, reduce_only, started_ms and pre-send MASTER truth needed for reconciliation. After the exchange response, durably attach oid/exchange status when available, but API acknowledgement never clears the reservation. Restart loads unresolved reservations before any new order authority and resolves them from independent MASTER evidence. Missing oid in the crash window is not permission to resend: reconcile from start_ms plus intent attributes; ambiguous evidence remains blocking. Partial fill persists the remaining reservation. Full independently proven settlement or independently proven no-fill terminal rejection may clear it. No new store/database/file is authorised.

HIP3_SETTLEMENT_RULE=Enumerate all required perp DEX scopes from perpDexs and query MASTER userFillsByTime per scope with the dex field, including default and every HIP-3/builder DEX. Do not rely on the current SDK helper if it omits dex; the existing raw read-only /info fetch seam may send the documented payload directly. Any required scope unavailable/unreadable => settlement truth unavailable and the reservation remains blocking. Deduplicate fills deterministically before settlement matching.

TERMINAL_REJECT_EVIDENCE_RULE=A caller-supplied boolean is never sufficient. A no-fill terminal clear requires an exchange-derived terminal rejection/refusal for that send attempt AND independent post-attempt MASTER truth across every required DEX showing no matching fill. If an oid was accepted/returned, any matching open/fill evidence or inability to prove absence keeps the reservation blocking. Local pre-send validation refusal may discard a reservation only when exchange.order was provably never invoked. Ambiguous/timeout/transport-error outcomes remain IN_FLIGHT_UNKNOWN, never terminal-rejected by assumption.

UNRELATED_INVENTORY_ATTRIBUTION_RULE=Protect same-coin pre-existing/manual inventory by maintaining an ownership partition inside EXISTING SERVICE_STATE_FILE, not a new store. At a no-send recovery/baseline boundary, reconstruct confirmed copy-owned actual from durable own-intent/send/MASTER-settlement evidence where possible, then freeze UNATTRIBUTED_BASELINE[coin] = authoritative MASTER net - confirmed copy-owned net. This snapshot establishes attribution only; it creates ZERO desired/trading authority. Thereafter only independently confirmed fills belonging to this engine may mutate copy-owned actual. Snapshots/restarts may verify but must never silently rewrite the unattributed baseline. Any later external/manual same-coin change or mismatch produces RECONCILIATION_DIVERGENCE and blocks new order authority until explicit no-send rebaseline/adjudication. Missing/corrupt attribution state fails closed; deterministic reconstruction from existing durable logs/evidence is allowed.

RECONCILIATION_GATE_RULE=Wire reconciliation into production authority: before convergence can authorise a new send, authoritative MASTER net must reconcile to UNATTRIBUTED_BASELINE + confirmed copy-owned actual +/- currently reserved unresolved exposure within the defined numerical tolerance. Divergence/stale/incomplete truth blocks; it never rewrites event lineage or desired exposure.

SETTLEMENT_LIFECYCLE_RULE=Wire the real sender result into the reservation: persist pre-send reservation, execute the single existing exchange.order site, persist oid/status, then invoke/queue bounded settlement reconciliation using MASTER per-DEX fills and resulting MASTER position. Do not clear on ORDER_FILLED/ack prose alone; only the independent evidence rule clears. Reconciliation may occur immediately and on restart/subsequent loop iterations until resolved.

PERSISTENCE_INVARIANT=Invariant no-new-persistent-store remains intact. New fields in the EXISTING SERVICE_STATE_FILE are authorised only as durability/safety checkpoints for unresolved sends, confirmed engine-owned actual and frozen unrelated-inventory attribution. They are not sources of desired trading authority. Existing append-only audit/send logs may be used for deterministic reconstruction.

G3_CORRECTION_SCOPE=Correct only the seven Controller defects A-G and focused regressions. Preserve fixed-mode HOLD, G2 event-authority semantics, one sender, existing UI/lifecycle boundaries. No G4 work and no mainnet/live activation.

G3_ACCEPTANCE=Controller must re-review exact corrected commits and executed evidence proving production MASTER runtime initialisation with signer separation; no production account_net fallback; durable pre-send in-flight persistence and restart recovery including crash-before-oid; sender-to-settlement wiring; per-dex HIP-3/default userFillsByTime coverage; evidence-based terminal rejection/no-fill; frozen unrelated baseline plus confirmed engine-owned actual across restart; divergence gating before send; partial/full/unknown settlement behaviour; unrelated inventory protection; legacy+G2 regressions; exactly one order site; <=400 gross G3 additions across <=2 production files; refreshed Graphify.

NEXT_ACTION=Controller issue exactly one bounded G3 correction to Hermes. If corrected G3 passes, wake Architect before G4. If the 400-line/two-file tripwire would be exceeded, escalate before implementing beyond it.
STAND_DOWN_PERMISSION=DENIED_WHILE_NEXT_ACTION_EXISTS
